literalObservedJoinedExamples.note: Morphology example only; table root spelling must follow separate project root choice.

edgeCases.recommendation: Preserve the final ा. Append the suffix spelling directly; do not delete or coalesce stem vowels.
Preserve final ो before को; do not attach a virama or rewrite vowel signs.
Preserve final ो before मा; limited exact-source scope retained.
Research only, not a new root in this change. If later admitted, preserve final long ी before endings.

implementationRecommendations: Use complete-root plus complete-suffix matching over the 19 explicit suffix keys. Longest root/ending matching must be deterministic; exact custom/full entries retain precedence.
Derive only from the reviewed built-in loanword catalogue, not every ordinary Roman Nepali lexicon entry or arbitrary custom stem.
Append full Unicode suffix spelling to each ordered root candidate. Never remove the root final vowel or add half-sound virama during joining.
Keep selected suffix keys literal and case-sensitive after the existing Shift controls; do not broadly lowercase T/D/S/R/contextual H.
Do not add recursive suffix chains, automatic typo repair, or unsourced Roman suffix aliases. sangai and haru+sangai are deferred from the initial slice.

Describe productive derivation honestly: grammatical material is attested, but every generated root+ending combination is not separately verified. Conversion does not validate sentence grammar or choose genitive agreement for the user.
Preserve URL/domain/email literals and English-only modes via the existing outer text/DOM policies.

deferred.reason: Whole मिडियासँगै is indexed in Press Council original article https://www.presscouncilnepal.gov.np/np/2023/12/14/8200/, but direct open failed. Initial slice is intentionally 19 explicit keys; this adverbial/emphatic extension can be reviewed separately.

sources.title: Office of Company Registrar — registration information
sources.support: Direct institutional usage preserves the vowel-final stem कम्पनी before case/genitive endings. Relevant text appears around lines 143–179. Attestation, not a normative ranking.

sources.title: Office of Company Registrar — scope of work
sources.support: Direct plural and plural-plus-postposition usage at lines 117–120. Long ऊ in हरू is directly attested; source does not prescribe a Roman input convention.

sources.title: Office of Company Registrar — monitoring arrangements
sources.support: Direct HTML at lines 123 and 144 contains the joined ablative, dative and plural dative forms.

sources.title: Introduction to the Nepali Language — Chapter 6 Unit 4 Grammar Focus
sources.support: Original instructional text explicitly describes noun+मा attachment, and directly joined location words including माथि. स्कुलमा at line 1013; टेबलमाथि at line 771. Its licensed content is cited through short examples, not incorporated wholesale.

sources.title: Introduction to the Nepali Language — Chapter 4 Unit 4 Grammar Focus
sources.support: Original instruction explains that को/की/का attach to the owner and agree with the thing owned. This supports the endings as morphology, not a claim that every generated loanword phrase is grammatical in every context.

sources.title: Nepal Police — information dissemination by central spokesperson
sources.support: Original police article directly uses whole मिडियासँग at line 7, as well as the base मिडिया. Stronger current access than the historical Press Council indexed PDF evidence.

sources.title: Armed Police Force Women’s Association — activities
sources.support: Original institutional activity descriptions contain both short-u and long-u school spelling variants. स्कूलमा at line 2177; स्कुलमा at lines 196, 481 and elsewhere. Both are attested; no unique spelling preference or usage frequency is inferred.

sources.title: Nepal Telecom — consolidated financial statements 2077/78
sources.support: Search-indexed financial-report excerpt contains the whole joined form कम्पनीहरूमाथि. Direct web fetch refused the 10,842,471-byte PDF, and no visual page was inspected. Surrounding extracted text has errors, so preserve limited confidence and access scope.

sources.title: Nepal Law Journal — decision 9344
sources.support: Original Supreme Court decision HTML contains कम्पनीसँग around paragraph 26 and कम्पनीहरूलाई at paragraph 31. This corroborates joined singular comitative and plural dative morphology.

sources.title: Nepal Police — social media character-assassination arrest report
sources.support: Original police article uses भिडियोको at line 70, preserving vowel-final भिडियो before को. Context is a social-media video.

sources.title: Suryodaya Municipality — coffee crop FAQ
sources.support: Original municipality agriculture FAQ directly shows long-i stem कफी before multiple endings. This is an edge-case spelling research note only; coffee is not added to the shipped loanword roots by this change.

sources.title: Radio Nepal — Jhankar 2079 annual publication
sources.support: Indexed original Radio Nepal publication excerpt directly contains रेडियोमा. Full PDF and visual page were not inspected in this review; spelling is useful as an edge case but limited-scope attestation.
